## About
Drainiology is a plumbing company in Phoenix, run by owner Shane. A lot of our work is below the surface: main sewer lines clogged with tree roots, damaged pipe that needs lining, and lines that need a camera to see what's really going on.
We'd rather explain the problem than rush through it. Customers tell us they like that we take the time to show them what's wrong, lay out the options, and make sure they're comfortable with the plan before we start.
We're rated 5 on Google from 31 reviews, and we'd be glad to take a look at whatever's going on with your plumbing.

## Services
- Roots in the main sewer line: Fixing main sewer lines that have filled with roots from trees growing above them.
- CIPP pipe-lining: Lining damaged pipe from the inside instead of digging it all out.
- Camera checking of lines: Running a camera through your lines to see what's going on inside the pipe.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Our listed hours are open 24 hours, every day of the week, Monday through Sunday.

Q: Will fixing my sewer line tear up my slab?
A: One customer said their damaged sewer line was fixed with little or no damage to their concrete slab. We'll look at your line and explain what to expect before starting.

Q: Will you explain the problem before you start?
A: Yes. One reviewer said we explained what was going on, walked through the options, and made sure they were comfortable with the plan before doing anything.
